Question 10
?

For the function G(s)=1s(s2+π2),s>0 find the inverse Laplace transform of G(s), given that L{sin⁡(ωt)}=ωs2+ω2.

a
1π2(1−cos⁡(2t))
b
1π2(1−sin⁡(πt))
c
1π2(1−cos⁡(πt))
d
1π2cos⁡(πt)
e
1π2(1−sin⁡(2t))
